Extraction API Reference

Use the extraction endpoint to request clean Markdown, metadata, links, and provenance for agent workflows.

from agentcrawl import AgentCrawl
crawler = AgentCrawl({"fetcher": "http"})
doc = crawler.scrape("https://example.com")

formatsarrayno
